glossEn: an unstable situation of extreme danger or difficulty
note: an unstable situation of extreme danger or difficulty。线索：financial / economic / energy + crisis。与 s2 分界：危机是**危险且失控**，紧要关头只是**关键节点**。

glossEn: a crucial stage or turning point in the course of something
note: a crucial stage or turning point in the course of something。线索：reach a / at a crisis（到关头）。也常用于医学（clinical crisis = 危象）。
